statusHistory.note: Operator request (chat, 2026-09-21/22): sixth Salvador pin, explicitly a non-LGBT nightlife pick to balance the earlier SAN (LGBTQIA+) pin. Clube do Samba is a root-samba house in Pelourinho founded December 2, 2007 by Wilson and Nelma ('afro-entrepreneurs,' per Portal Soteropreta) as the Associação dos Amigos do Samba Brasileiro, now on its current site (formerly Bar Fundo do Cravinho, literally next door to O Cravinho at Largo Terreiro de Jesus — same street, different numbers, a legitimate near-miss not a duplicate). Resident band Rara Raiz, led by Vagner Santana, has anchored the room for over a decade; the venue has hosted 5,000+ rodas de samba across nearly 19 years. Google Maps verified live via browser: 4.7 stars, 164 reviews, R$40-100/person, Largo Terreiro de Jesus 05. Deliberately included, in good faith and briefly, a real documented episode: a 2025 social-media dispute over the venue's racial inclusivity as white attendance grew, and owner Dona Nelma's on-record response reaffirming the space's commitment to diversity — handled factually and proportionately per near-legal-counsel's standard (reporting that the exchange happened, not amplifying the underlying allegation as settled fact). Instagram (@clubedosamba1, Meta-verified, 54K followers) confirmed the current address, the recurring Saturday 'Rara Raiz' night (20h start), and supplied a real, non-AI candid photo from a recent post for the hero. No single forward-dated event was nested — the Saturday night slot is a standing weekly fixture, not a one-off, so it's described in the body rather than claimed as a dated event with a specific date. Single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive.
